name: azure-storage-blob
title: Azure Storage Blob Service
description: Store and retrieve blobs from Azure Storage Blob Service.
label: cloud,file

properties.name: accountName
properties.description: Azure account name to be used for authentication with azure blob services

properties.name: containerName
properties.description: The blob container name

properties.name: blobName
properties.label: common
properties.description: The blob name, to consume specific blob from a container. However, on producer it is only required for the operations on the blob level

properties.name: blobOffset
properties.label: common
properties.description: Set the blob offset for the upload or download operations, default is 0

properties.name: blobServiceClient
properties.description: Client to a storage account. This client does not hold any state about a particular storage account but is instead a convenient way of sending off appropriate requests to the resource on the service. It may also be used to construct URLs to blobs and containers. This client contains operations on a service account. Operations on a container are available on BlobContainerClient through getBlobContainerClient(String), and operations on a blob are available on BlobClient through getBlobContainerClient(String).getBlobClient(String).

properties.name: blobType
properties.label: common
properties.description: The blob type in order to initiate the appropriate settings for each blob type

properties.name: closeStreamAfterRead
properties.description: Close the stream after read or keep it open, default is true

properties.name: credentials
properties.description: StorageSharedKeyCredential can be injected to create the azure client, this holds the important authentication information

properties.name: credentialType
properties.label: common
properties.description: Determines the credential strategy to adopt

properties.name: dataCount
properties.label: common
properties.description: How many bytes to include in the range. Must be greater than or equal to 0 if specified.

properties.name: fileDir
properties.label: common
properties.description: The file directory where the downloaded blobs will be saved to, this can be used in both, producer and consumer

properties.name: leaseBlob
properties.label: common
properties.description: Sets whether a lease should be acquired when accessing the blob. When set to true, the component will acquire a lease before performing blob operations that require exclusive access.

properties.name: leaseDurationInSeconds
properties.label: common
properties.description: Sets the lease duration in seconds. Use -1 for infinite or a value between 15 and 60 for fixed leases.

properties.name: maxResultsPerPage
properties.label: common
properties.description: Specifies the maximum number of blobs to return, including all BlobPrefix elements. If the request does not specify maxResultsPerPage or specifies a value greater than 5,000, the server will return up to 5,000 items.

properties.name: maxRetryRequests
properties.label: common
properties.description: Specifies the maximum number of additional HTTP Get requests that will be made while reading the data from a response body.

properties.name: prefix
properties.label: common
properties.description: Filters the results to return only blobs whose names begin with the specified prefix. May be null to return all blobs.

properties.name: regex
properties.label: common
properties.description: Filters the results to return only blobs whose names match the specified regular expression. May be null to return all if both prefix and regex are set, regex takes the priority and prefix is ignored.

properties.name: serviceClient
properties.description: Client to a storage account. This client does not hold any state about a particular storage account but is instead a convenient way of sending off appropriate requests to the resource on the service. It may also be used to construct URLs to blobs and containers. This client contains operations on a service account. Operations on a container are available on BlobContainerClient through BlobServiceClient#getBlobContainerClient(String), and operations on a blob are available on BlobClient through BlobContainerClient#getBlobClient(String).

properties.name: snapshotId
properties.label: common
properties.description: The snapshot identifier used to target a specific blob snapshot on read operations (getBlob, downloadBlobToFile, downloadLink). When set, the read targets the snapshot scoped client instead of the live blob. Can also be provided per-exchange via the CamelAzureStorageBlobSnapshotId header.

properties.name: timeout
properties.label: common
properties.description: An optional timeout value beyond which a RuntimeException will be raised.

properties.name: versionId
properties.label: common
properties.description: The blob version identifier used to target a specific blob version on read operations (getBlob, downloadBlobToFile, downloadLink). Requires blob versioning to be enabled on the storage account. When set, the read targets the version scoped client instead of the live blob. Can also be provided per-exchange via the CamelAzureStorageBlobVersionId header.

properties.name: deleteAfterRead
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Delete blobs from Azure after they have been retrieved. The delete is only performed if the Exchange is committed. If a rollback occurs, the blob is not deleted. If this option is false, then the same blobs will be retrieved over and over again in the polls. Therefore, you need to use the Idempotent Consumer EIP in the route to filter out duplicates. You can filter using the BlobConstants#BLOB_NAME header, or only the blob name.

properties.name: destinationBlobPrefix
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Define the destination blob prefix to use when a blob must be moved, and moveAfterRead is set to true.

properties.name: destinationBlobSuffix
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Define the destination blob suffix to use when a blob must be moved, and moveAfterRead is set to true.

properties.name: destinationContainer
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Define the destination container where a blob must be moved when moveAfterRead is set to true.

properties.name: moveAfterRead
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Move blobs from the container to a different container after they have been retrieved. To accomplish the operation, the destinationContainer option must be set. The copy blob operation is only performed if the Exchange is committed. If a rollback occurs, the blob is not moved.

properties.name: removePrefixOnMove
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Remove the contents of the prefix configuration string from the new blob name before moving. For example, if prefix is set to 'notify/' and the destinationBlobPrefix is set to 'archive/', a blob with a name of 'notify/example.txt' will be moved to 'archive/example.txt', rather than the default behavior where the new name is 'archive/notify/example.txt'. Only applicable when moveAfterRead is true.

properties.name: sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: pollStrategy
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

properties.name: blobSequenceNumber
properties.label: producer
properties.description: A user-controlled value that you can use to track requests. The value of the sequence number must be between 0 and 263 - 1.The default value is 0.

properties.name: blockListType
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Specifies which type of blocks to return.

properties.name: blockSize
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The block size in bytes to use for chunked uploads with uploadBlockBlobChunked operation. Default is 4MB (4194304). Maximum is 4000MB. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: changeFeedContext
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When using getChangeFeed producer operation, this gives additional context that is passed through the Http pipeline during the service call.

properties.name: changeFeedEndTime
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When using getChangeFeed producer operation, this filters the results to return events approximately before the end time. Note: A few events belonging to the next hour can also be returned. A few events belonging to this hour can be missing; to ensure all events from the hour are returned, round the end time up by an hour.

properties.name: changeFeedStartTime
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When using getChangeFeed producer operation, this filters the results to return events approximately after the start time. Note: A few events belonging to the previous hour can also be returned. A few events belonging to this hour can be missing; to ensure all events from the hour are returned, round the start time down by an hour.

properties.name: closeStreamAfterWrite
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Close the stream after write or keep it open, default is true

properties.name: commitBlockListLater
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When is set to true, the staged blocks will not be committed directly.

properties.name: createAppendBlob
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When is set to true, the append blocks will be created when committing append blocks.

properties.name: createPageBlob
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When is set to true, the page blob will be created when uploading page blob.

properties.name: downloadLinkExpiration
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Override the default expiration (millis) of URL download link.

properties.name: maxConcurrency
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The maximum number of parallel requests to use during upload with uploadBlockBlobChunked operation. Default is determined by the Azure SDK based on available processors.

properties.name: maxSingleUploadSize
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The maximum size in bytes for a single upload request with uploadBlockBlobChunked operation. Files smaller than this will be uploaded in a single request. Files larger will use chunked upload with blocks of size blockSize. Default is 256MB.

properties.name: operation
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The blob operation that can be used with this component on the producer

properties.name: pageBlobSize
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Specifies the maximum size for the page blob, up to 8 TB. The page blob size must be aligned to a 512-byte boundary.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: backoffErrorThreshold
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

properties.name: backoffIdleThreshold
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

properties.name: backoffMultiplier
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

properties.name: delay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Milliseconds before the next poll.

properties.name: greedy
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

properties.name: initialDelay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

properties.name: repeatCount
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

properties.name: runLoggingLevel
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

properties.name: scheduledExecutorService
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

properties.name: scheduler
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

properties.name: schedulerProperties
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

properties.name: startScheduler
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

properties.name: timeUnit
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

properties.name: useFixedDelay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

properties.name: accessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Access key for the associated azure account name to be used for authentication with azure blob services

properties.name: azureClientId
properties.label: security
properties.description: Azure Client ID for authentication with Azure Identity

properties.name: azureClientSecret
properties.label: security
properties.description: Azure Client Secret for authentication with Azure Identity

properties.name: azureTenantId
properties.label: security
properties.description: Azure Tenant ID for authentication with Azure Identity

properties.name: sasToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: In case of usage of Shared Access Signature we'll need to set a SAS Token

properties.name: sourceBlobAccessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Source Blob Access Key: for copyblob operation, sadly, we need to have an accessKey for the source blob we want to copy Passing an accessKey as header, it's unsafe so we could set as key.
